snippet.title: Elsewhere Electric - Official Release Date Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Check out the Release Date Trailer for Elsewhere Electric, a VR co-op puzzle game developed by Games by Stitch. Players will work together to produce a charge for devices, solve puzzles, and more to reveal the secrets of an abnormal facility. Don't miss the latest trailer to see gameplay of Elsewhere Electric, launching on July 23 for SteamVR and Meta Quest.
